image_measurements.method: User-provided PNG. For each bounded endpoint crop, centroid all pixels with R,G,B > 220; ruler endpoints are white markers. For each pose crop, find the lowest row of warm silhouette pixels satisfying R > 170, R-G > 5, G-B > 3.

evidence.capture_source: Project owner supplied the screenshot in the conversation; archived without image edits.

script_changes.sprites: Generate one transparent P4 cell PNG per pose from the atlas, import each as its own texture, and sample it directly in a masked Unlit material.
script_changes.shadow: Build a radial translucent ellipse from Length/Subtract/Max/Power nodes with verified pin names, compile-check it, and use 0.45 center opacity.

validation: The user-provided runtime image measures within frozen tolerances for the center-depth 1000 uu X ruler (+0.857 px vs 1510.739 target, tolerance ±8 px), 185 uu depth ruler (-0.550 px vs 234.459 target, tolerance ±5 px), and same-depth pose foot baseline (0 px difference, tolerance ≤2 px). These pixel checks do not close W1: target-PC frame-time data, dynamic DepthY ordering and shadow readability, DataTable CSV reimport without C++ rebuild, A0 approval/art budget and production direction coverage remain open.

image_measurements.method: 1920x1080 saved PNG. Ruler endpoints use connected bright marker pixels (all RGB channels > 220), centroid per marker; sprite lower edges use warm silhouette pixels in each pose crop (R > 170, R-G > 5, G-B > 3).

previous_review.validation: UE 5.8.3 Standalone rendered 1920x1080. One pose per actor is visible and upright; the final log has no material compile/default-material failure. The saved screenshot's front-edge X ruler measures within 0.1% of its local geometric target; the Y ruler and same-depth pose baseline are within their targets. This does not pass the frozen X baseline because that ruler was at DepthY=7 instead of the required center depth 92.5. The preview builder now places it at center depth; a new render is pending. Shadow contrast, frame-time sampling, production animation and three-direction coverage remain open.

render_area_note: The image bounds include the runtime window title bar. Pixel spans are measured between in-scene ruler markers; vertical offsets from the title bar cancel in span and foot-delta measurements.
